tool_args.rationale: The response saturates at the largest observed gradient (2.44), near the archived avalanche critical range (about 2.50–2.68). A high-s_grad probe directly tests for the threshold-dependent downturn before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: author a stationary siphon model now (nodes C/D)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations couple increasing u_now with increasing s_grad and stop just below the proposed avalanche threshold; inhibition and threshold effects are not identifiable.
The evidence is at one fixed horizon and does not point to coupled memory dynamics; a high-gradient measurement is more directly discriminating.
Irrelevant to the candidate mechanisms and explicitly not worth acquiring.
